result.description:
The team at Flexiforce are seeking an experienced and mechanically-minded Factory Hand for a manufacturing company in Goulburn, NSW.

The successful applicant will possess a solid range of relevant skillsets acquired from within the field, with a background of machinery operation or mechanical engineering, to better assist in the manufacturing, production, and fabrication of mechanical components.
The ideal candidate will also be open to receiving potential training of the site’s CNC machining processes.

This role offers ongoing employment, Monday-Friday from 7am-3pm, and is an immediate start.

Police check or willingness to obtain one is essential. LF Forklift Licence is highly regarded.

Main criteria:
•	Prior experience in a similar role
•	Background of machinery operation or mechanical engineering 
•	Strong underlying knowledge and a solid range of skillsets in the field
•	Physically capable of manual handling
•	Great work ethic and can-do-attitude
•	Eagerness to learn on the job
•	Excellent attention to detail
•	Efficient time management skills
•	Effective communication and comprehension skillsets
•	Ability to work in a team environment or without supervision
•	Strong focus on safety practices within the workplace


Reliability is a MUST!

If this sounds like you and you want to apply, please apply ASAP!
Email your resume to enquiries@flexiforce.com.au 
Any queries, contact our team 02 4869 5505

If you do not include your resume, this will mark the application as incomplete.

result.description:
Dunns Engineering is currently looking to recruit an experienced and qualified Welder / Metal Fabricator to join their team in Deniliquin NSW.

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

- Being able to read and analyse blueprints and drawings
- Have the ability and experience to use a TIG and MIG welder
- Examining welds for the width of bead, penetration and precision
- Have the ability to weld vertically, horizontally and overhead
- Be able to weld various metals using various techniques
- Cut, roll, shape, bend, mould, spin, heat or hammer metal products to fabricate parts or sub-assemblies
- Heat treat metal parts and components
- Set up and/or operate hand and machine tools, welding equipment
- Assemble parts and structures by lining up and joining them by welding, bolting or riveting
- Finish products by cleaning, polishing, filing or bathing them in acid solutions, or by applying protective or decorative coatings.

Skills & Abilities:   

- Certificate III in Engineering (Welding Fabrication) or equivalent qualification
- Minimum of three years’ experience in this role or similar
- Ability to work in a team environment 

Salary range is $70,000-$85,000pa commensurate with experience

Fulltime Position available

Applications open on 8th July 2026 and closes on  8th August 2026. 

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

result.description:
Macs Engineering are currently looking to recruit an experienced and qualified Sheetmetal Worker to join their team in Mackay QLD.


The successful applicants will need to possess and undertake:

- Have a willingness to work with strong attention to detail
- Be punctual and responsible
- Proficiency in both MIG and TIG welding
- Ability to read and interpret drawings to fine specifications
- Experience in handling a range of materials, including difficult materials
- Experience with materials such as steel, aluminium & polymer
- Cutting material, weld prep, grinding
- Adherence to WHS
- Select types of sheetmetal according to building or design plans
- Measure and mark dimensions and reference lines on metal sheets
- Duct fabrication in some roles
- Install metal sheets with supportive frameworks
- Fabricate or alter parts at construction sites
- Manoeuvre and anchor large sheet metal parts

Skills & Attributes:

- At least 3 years’ experience in steel/aluminium sheetmetal and/or duct fabrication
- Certificate III in Engineering (Fabrication) or equivalent
- Ability to work in a team environment 

Salary range is $70,000-$85,000pa commensurate with experience

Fulltime Position available


Applications open on 27th July 2026 and closes on 27th August 2026


If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
